desc: Prove even-interval formula (sum of largest half minus sum of smallest half) and odd-index survivor constraint.
Implement O(N log N) prefix/suffix computation using two heaps (max-heap of k//2 smallest + min-heap of rest) tracking totalSum and lowerSum.
Scan left-to-right to compute pref[k] for every even prefix length k (score = total - 2*lowerSum).
Scan right-to-left to compute suf[j] for every even suffix length j.
Combine: if N even output pref[N]; if N odd output max over even s of pref[s] + suf[N-1-s].
Validate against all 3 samples (5, 14, 0) — PASSED; plus hand cases N=2, all-equal, monotone, duplicates.
Drop superseded Fenwick approach in favor of the faster two-heap method.
